description: D-14a sealed asset format v1 (contracts/devsecops/cli-v1.md, asset-encryption, 'Formato selado v1'). Generated by verification/devsecops/gen_sealed_vectors.py; checked by verification/devsecops/test_sealed_vectors.py; to be used by the CLI (D-14c), the Android SDK reader and the Flutter plugin (D-14b). Every dek, salt and nonce here is SHA-256 of a 'TEST ONLY' label: never a real key (the CLI draws them from SecureRandom on every run). kFmt is the public format constant. Hex is lower case; entries are named as bundletool lists the base module, without 'base/'. deflatedHex is one valid raw DEFLATE stream, not the only one a writer may emit.

kFmt.derivation: SHA-256(ASCII "Sentomaru sealed assets format v1 public constant")

negative.name: header-before-path
negative.rule: the header is checked before the path

negative.name: header-too-large
negative.rule: header.bin above 593 bytes is refused before AEAD

negative.name: asset-aad-other-version-code
negative.rule: the asset AAD carries the versionCode

negative.name: asset-aad-other-package
negative.rule: the asset AAD carries the package

negative.name: asset-entry-too-large
negative.rule: an entry above 4198437 bytes is refused before AEAD

negative.name: asset-length-above-limit
negative.rule: a declared length above 4 MiB is refused even with a valid tag

negative.name: asset-inflates-beyond-declared
negative.rule: inflation stops at declared + 1 bytes (valid tag; the stream holds 1 MiB)

negative.name: asset-trailing-bytes
negative.rule: bytes after the end of the stream (valid tag)

negative.name: asset-deflate-truncated
negative.rule: a stream without its final block, already at the declared length, is not complete (valid tag)

negative.name: strings-not-an-object
negative.rule: the strings JSON is not a flat object (valid tag)

negative.name: strings-not-utf8
negative.rule: the strings file is not UTF-8 (valid tag)

negative.name: strings-absent-in-header
negative.rule: string() in a package sealed without strings
